newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: PRESS DIGEST - Czech Republic - March 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Czech Republic - March 11.

text.p: HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Consumer prices were 0.3 percent higher in February than in January. Experts consider this result favourable, because the average inflation rate last month was 0.7 percent.

- The cabinet should reach a definite decision tomorrow on how energy prices and rents will increase from July of this year. It should also approve a concept for social support for higher living expenses and housing construction.
- Investicni a Postovni Banka sold a total of 5.9 percent of shares in Skoda Plzen to Ceska Pojistovna in the last few days.

LIDOVE NOVINY - The administrative council of Czech Railways accepted Rudolf Mladek's resignation and voted in Vladimir Sosna as the new general director. According to the chairman of the railway workers union Jaromir Dusek, Sosna does not deserve the position.

- President Vaclav Havel met with Romanian President Emil Constantinesk in Prague yesterday. They agreed that integration of former Eastern block countries into NATO should not be a contest, but a matter of cooperation.
PRAVO - Ceska Pojistovna issued policies worth a total of 26.2 billion crowns in 1996, of which seven billion was life insurance and 19.2 billion was non-life insurance.
- Severoceske Doly had profits after taxes of 1.15 billion crowns last year.
- The Czech branch of the Swedish telecommunications firm Ericsson had a turnover of 1.058 billion crowns last year, an increase of 76 percent over 1995.
- The Finance Ministry did not allow Harvard Capital & Consulting to transform its closed-end funds into open funds, a spokeswoman for the ministry, Ludmila Nutilova, said on Monday.
MLADA FRONTA DNES - The Social Democrats are finishing a proposal for an administrative law to increase the number of territorial autonomous units and will present it to parliament soon.

- Interior Minister Jan Ruml announced that by the end of April, he and Justice Minister Vlasta Parkanova will propose a new criminal law on narcotics, which will primarily concern holding drugs for personal use.
- Radio Nova Alfa paid a fine of one million crowns to the Council for Radio and Television Broadcasting yesterday, because it changed its programming without the council's permission.
- Motoinvest Group revealed its property holdings. It said it was unsuccessful in selling 1.C.A.S. Holding and Creditanstalt Czech infrastructure investment fund and C.A.S. 9. Holding.
